import { useStateColor } from "../lib/css-motion";
import { useCadenceMotion } from "../lib/provider";

export function Fixture() {
  const cm = useCadenceMotion();
  const paint = useStateColor(undefined, cm, ["background-color", "color"]);
  return <span {...paint} data-slot="fixture" data-motion={cm.mode}>State</span>;
}

export function Plain() {
  return <span data-slot="fixture-plain">Native</span>;
}
